passive.name: Bravado
passive.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.description: Passive: Gain a stack (max ) every seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack. Active: Consume all stacks to restore Health per stack to nearby ally champions ( at stacks).
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Bastion
spells.description: Passive: Taric gains Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally. Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a % max Health Shield for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.description: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after second to deal magic damage and Stun enemies for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: An explicit live-patch duel module resolves this champion-specific damage packet.

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.description: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
